title: Indonesia Digital and AI data-center facility geographic register
scope: Province-specific physical facilities/campuses in DKI Jakarta and West Java; AWS and Microsoft cloud-region AZ addresses deliberately not geolocated.
classification: A colocation/data center may support AI, but listing as Digital / AI does NOT establish GPU infrastructure or live AI training cluster. Operator-disclosed full-build capacity, campus capacity and energized IT load must not be added. Parent and sub-campus overlaps explicitly labeled.
